timing_scope: Serial fresh-process e9 encodes, one discarded warmup per variant/input, then interleaved variants. Encoder API CPU/wall includes all preparation, learning and entropy; input unpack, decode and file IO outside. Per-encode learning CPU/wall sums include all LearnTree events. Trace runs include pixel/metadata IO and are excluded from all timing conclusions. No thread pool; uncontrolled desktop.
limits: Workflow ablation: buffering changes tree, transform and entropy scope; not a pure tree-scope attribution.
All learning/fit times are summed per encode before taking medians; trace and warmup runs excluded.
Learning-input equality is a multiset of pixel/shape/option/transform signatures, not spatial or sample-set equality.
Captured pixels are little-endian signed int32 in tight channel rows; excluded channels retain metadata but no pixels.
Learning traces include actual raw trees and every included pixel checked against disk; coding traces cover global/local stream headers.
No native search-policy/default change or held-out qualification is implied.

build_validation.scope: Release and ASan/UBSan suites; global/photo, local/palette and true 16-bit captures. Native, harness and generated reference units instrumented; linked archives uninstrumented; vptr excluded; UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1. Sanitizer times are not performance evidence.
